headline: U.S. Air Force Global Strike Command conducted a test launch of an unarmed 'Minuteman III' intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) from Vandenberg Space Force Base, California, at 11:01 p.m. Pacific Time last night. The Air Force says test launches assess the entirety of the ICBM enterprise and provide data to inform ICBM sustainment, engineering and lifecycle analysis. It has completed over 300 Minuteman III test launches. The test was designated 'Glory Trip 257', was scheduled years ago and is not in response to world events, according to the Air Force. Flight tracking data from @flightradar24 suggests a U.S. Navy E-6B Mercury was involved. It departed Vandenberg about two hours before the launch, orbited over the Pacific south of the base, in a position associated with E-6s who previously participated in launches, and returned about an hour afterward.

headline: A roughly 200 meter section of the Kerch Bridge roadway fell into the Kerch Strait after a Ukrainian strike overnight November 17 to 18. headline: Greece's EYP and North Macedonia's ANB have foiled an alleged Iranian plot to carry out a terror attack or assassination in Greece. The target was an Israeli executive in Greece, according to sources. The executive was not named. Five North Macedonian nationals were arrested. Weapons, maps and notes were seized. The joint operation has been running since early 2026. The ANB named Iranian national Edris Jahangiri Mavaneh as the man directing the network. He is linked to Iranian security services and to drug lord Naji Sharifi Zindashti, per the ANB. The network held secret meetings in third countries, including Iran. It relied on local criminal ties for logistics.
